articles.title: Seedream 5.0 Lite Guide: Features, Benchmarks & API

articles.title: Seedance 2.0 Review: ByteDance Tops AI Video in 2026
articles.exc: ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 launched in March 2026 with unified multimodal architecture supporting text, images, audio, and video inputs for 1080p generation.
